drive.rule: Crossroads recipe (docs/animation/attacker-recoil-rule.md, proof section): swing length times 10/18, deeper load

actions: Imported the shipped GLB (Draco decoded by the Blender importer) at 30 fps. Put every bone at rest before each clip sample.

Support (carve_left beat 2): the skate on the ground is levelled onto its wheels and rolls along its heading under the CoM (up to 21 cm) while the other skate is in the air; the knee IK points the knee over the moved skate.

Athletic stance (coast, push): hinge forward at the hips until the shoulders are over the knees, coast hips to 0.78 of the leg length, 80% of the hinge back in the neck and head, coast arms 12 degrees forward; the leg IK keeps the skates.
Centre of mass from Winter segment masses (60 kg body, 1.2 kg for each skate). Zero moment point (cart-table model) checked against the support polygon of the skates on the ground.

Inertia on rollers: removed part of the fore-aft CoM oscillation (push 50%, coast 80%, carve 70%). Balance: solved (I - K D2) C = ZMP* so that the ZMP goes into the support polygon. Vertical: a symmetric Gaussian filter, widened until the CoM vertical acceleration is in -0.45 g to +0.6 g. All by a periodic shift of the hips (largest 6 cm horizontal, 3 cm vertical).

Upper body: symmetric Gaussian (sigma 1.2 frames, no time shift) on the spine, neck, head, shoulder, and arm rotations; follow-through lag on the forearms (2 frames), hands (3 frames), and head (2 frames).

Wheels: a skate that never lifts more than 4 cm stays on the ground all clip long; a step skate gets only the penetration fix. A two-bone IK solve puts each ankle at its target with the old foot rotation and knee bend direction. The foot and toe keep their old armature-space matrices.

Faster push drive: each push drive (both skates down, from the touch-down of the other skate to the lift-off) is retimed to 10/18 of its frames by a monotone cubic time warp; the lift-off frames and the clip length stay, the other skate lands later, and the glide on one skate gets the saved frames. A 1 cm deeper CoM dip at the start of each drive. The hips may move 12 cm to the side in the push (6 cm in the other clips: 12 cm put the Nia carve knee 35 degrees off its hinge, a joint-limit WARN).

Recoil (Crossroads attacker recoil rule): at the end of each push stroke (the drive skate lifts), at each step that lands in the carve, and on each coast downbeat, one bounce along the momentum: 3 frames up to the stop frame, 4 frames back, the pelvis bounce on the target CoM path before the balance solve, then the chest, upper arms, and head 1, 2, and 3 frames later.

Joint limits (Crossroads gate #465, ported to the Mixamo rig in skater_joint_limits.py): every new clip PASS; the gate self-test catches a knee bent to the side, a hyperextended knee and elbow, and a spine bent 130 degrees.
carve_right: the mirror of the new carve_left across X = 0 (D' = S D S on the rest-relative matrices), with the same IK solve for the feet.

Clipping fix: limb capsules, knee spheres, and skate boxes (skater_clip_probe.py); a leg in the other leg moves its skate in the ground plane; a hand or forearm more than 2 cm in a thigh or knee swings the upper arm away; then the hips rebalance to the old CoM path. The mirrored carve gets the same fix.

Exported the 8 clips (push, coast, carve_left, carve_right, air_mute, air_japan, air_liukang, dance_prep) and the rig without Draco, then grafted them into skater.glb and skater-1024.glb (the #187 encoding; Draco on the mesh as before). The mesh, the textures, the rig, and the other clips do not change.
Landing recoil starts at the touch-down; carve landing drop weight 0.25; Nia's carve has no pelvis bounce at the landing.

Arm IK with hand targets (air_mute, air_japan, air_liukang, dance_prep): two-bone arm IK; grabs put the palm on the grabbed skate (the skate comes toward the hand inside the leg LIMITS, then the chest bends inside the spine LIMITS); claps meet once per beat.

actions: The clip probe now tests the forearms and the elbow end of the upper arms against the torso. The torso radius comes from the mesh in 16 directions and 4 bands, with the hips and the seat of the pants in the lowest band.

ARM_LOOSE (push, coast): more elbow bend (more at the front of the swing), a 2-frame forearm follow-through on the backswing, a 1-frame wrist lag, and the upper arm out from the body by up to 12 degrees at the back of the swing.
The clip fix swings an arm out from the body about the forward axis of the chest on every frame. The #313 fix used a new axis on each frame and made the arm jump up to 30 degrees in one frame.

Re-ran the full pass of #313 on the clips before #313, and grafted push, coast, carve_left, carve_right, air_mute, air_japan, air_liukang, and dance_prep. dance_walkitout and the other clips do not change.

Review fixes (2026-11-23): the wrist lag uses the right-handed order (fwd, side, up) of the chest frame, and ARM_OUT_MAX bounds the total swing-out of all clip-fix rounds. Rebuilt and grafted the same 8 clips.
